disconnect.title: Disconnect Google Workspace?
disconnect.description: {{email}} will be disconnected and its access revoked. Existing live sessions remain unaffected, but you won't be able to create new Google Meet sessions until you reconnect.

openAccess.title: Allow open join?
openAccess.description: With open join, <1>anyone who has the meeting link can join without knocking</1> — a Google Meet link is a plain URL with no passcode. Use this only if you're comfortable that the link is shared solely with enrolled learners through Vacademy. You can switch back to "require knock" anytime.
